batting.dismissal: c MS Dhoni b L Ngidi

balls.text: Rana palms it over the midwicket boundary. CSK finish the innings with a six, with some help from Rana. 119ks offcutter just a shade outside off. Jadeja sits so very deep in the crease and hauls it in the air. He gets more height as opposed to distance. Rana should've taken it at the edge of the boundary. Instead, he tips it over for six. Sums up the innings for KKR
slower ball offcutter outside off, Faf chucks his hands at the ball and edges it behind to DK. He gets the single
lifter outside off, Faf picks the length early. He jumps back and pummels a pull over square leg. Faf moves to 94
short and wide of off, slapped straight to Morgan at extra-cover. Another slower offcutter
pumped over long-off. Cracker of a shot from Faf. This is a hard-length delivery, nowhere near full. Faf jumps on top of it and punches it over the top. Even Russell was impressed
slower offcutter wide of off, Faf chucks his hands at the ball, loses his shape, and is beaten outside off

scythed flat and hard. Morgan swoops to his left and pulls off an outstanding catch. Wide yorker from Russell, Dhoni reaches out for the ball, hits it hard, and holes out for 17 off 8 balls. 15 off the over, though
banged in too short and slanting away wide of off, left alone from Dhoni. Wide called for height
wide yorker, stabbed out to sweeper cover. 200 up for CSK
another off-side wide from Russell
Russell straightens his line. Very full on middle, punched straight of long-on. Gill fumbles at the edge of the boundary and gives up four

Carved to the third-man fence. Russell's angle takes the ball away Faf. He slashes and gets it away to the left of the outfielder. Nagarkoti attacks the ball for the catch, dives forward, but the ball drops in front of him and reaches the fence
full and veering away outside off, Faf reaches out for the ball and falls on the floor in the process. But the ball is carved over short third man
back of a length and angling across off, off-side wide
rifled over midwicket. 146ks, back of a length and angling into off. Dhoni holds his shape and pulls flat and hard over the leg side
96.8ks slower ball on the stumps, Dhoni aims to haul it over midwicket. Instead, he top-edges it over Karthik's head
bumper down the leg side, wide called for height
Krishna pounds it on a hard length and outside off, 144ks, Dhoni has a leg-side hack...and misses
145ks shoulder-high short ball outside off, rushes Dhoni into a hook. Top-edged over midwicket
dipping full-toss on middle, Faf hauls it away to deep midwicket
bouncer on middle, gets big on Faf, who can't quite connect with the hook
fizzing offbreak from Narine, he drags his length back and hits the pad, but this heading down leg
pushed through outside off, Dhoni swings for the hills and outside-edges this free-hit fine of Russell at short third man. Dhoni's first boundary off Narine
dragged down on middle, Faf goes on the back foot and pulls to deep midwicket. The no-ball siren goes off
tossed up and outside off, Dhoni reaches out and slices it behind point for one

four, six, and out! Moeen ventures down the track and swings hard to the leg side again. Narine pulls his length back and brings this back into the left-hander. He misses, DK gathers it and takes the bails off. End of a charming cameo from Moeen
Mo has a heave-ho and sends the ball over midwicket. Moeen steps out again, Narine drags it shorter on middle, Moeen clubs it away with all his might
Such a smooth swing from Moeen. He dashes out, meets this full ball outside off early and lifts it over Narine's head
pitched up and outside off, Faf stays leg-side of this 142ks delivery and flays it straight to extra-cover
107ks slower ball outside off. Faf jumps across off, waits on it, before dropping low and scooping it fine of short fine leg
on-pace full-toss outside off at 145ks, rushes Faf, beats his bat and the off stump
pitched up and outside off, Faf now clears his front leg, drilling it straight to extra-cover
another slower ball on middle, Moeen swings too early and under-edges this offcutter just wide of DK
107.7ks slower ball outside off, Moeen manufactures his own pace. He clears his front leg, widens his base, and pumps it over long-off for six
good ball from Cummins again. The speed gun reckons it's 140ks, but it looked like the slower one to me. Short and wide of off, Cummins asks Faf to reach out for the ball. Sliced to extra-cover
slower ball outside off, stops at Moeen. He ends up flapping it behind square on the leg side
back of a length and on middle, on-pace delivery, Faf stays leg-side of it and stabs a single into the covers
slower ball on the hips, Moeen dinks it to short fine leg and sets off for a single
big bumper from Cummins, screams away outside off, Mooen shelves the hook. It trampolines over a leaping DK
Cummins isn't offering Faf pace. Good bowling. Slow, short, and away from his hitting arc. Slashed out to sweeper cover
Faf backs a long way outside leg, another slower offcutter from Cummins, but he has floated it past the tramline
Faf jumps across off for the scoop to fine leg, Cummins takes pace off and takes this offcutter away from Faf's reach. Dabbed away to the right of a tumbling DK to the third-man fence
slower ball, plunges sharply on middle, Moeen delays his drive and knocks it gently to cover
short and wide of off, another slower ball, Faf waits on it before heaving it away to the right of deep square leg. Fine save from Cummins. Fine running from CSK
much fuller and slanting into middle, Moeen has a roundhouse swipe at it and ends up dragging a thick inside edge to long leg
attacking intent from Moeen. Back of a length and Nagarkoti takes it wide of off. Moeen makes some room and carves it over extra-cover
short, wide, Moeen chucks his hands at the ball. Slapped in the air, bounces before the infielder gathers the ball
slower cutter, back of a length and spits up at Faf. He loosens his grip and jabs it to the covers
guided off his hips to the leg side for one. Excellent spell from Chakravarthy: 1 for 27
outside off, floaty. Driven to cover
short and speared wide of off, Varun cranks it up to 104.2ks. Faf jumps on top of it and scythes a four past point to raise a  half-century of his own
pushed through outside off, flat and quick, Moeen slog-sweeps along the ground to deep square leg

hauled to deep midwicket, where Cummins takes it. He slog-sweeps it in the air, the outfielder runs in, slides on his knees, and snaffles it. Raina gives the outgoing Gaikwad a high-five. Pushed through outside off, Gaikwad gets hold of the slog, but can't clear Cummins
short and wide of off, slapped off the back foot but straight to point
Gaikwad rides the bounce of this short ball outside off and glides it to the right of deep third man
slower dipper on middle, 94.2ks, that's slower than Jadeja's usual pace. Faf waits on it before chopping through the cover-point region
slower cutter, floated on middle, Gaikwad waits for the ball to arrive and dinks it through midwicket. He has to settle with a single
shanked over midwicket for six. Gaikwad is tearing into Krishna. He dashes out of the crease, picks this short ball off his body, and puts it into the second tier
Faf shuffles across off for the scoop fine of short fine leg. But this short ball gets big on him, he loses his balance, and top-edges it in front of the wicket, towards midwicket
shorter and outside off, Gaikwad chucks his hands at the ball and splices it to the left of sweeper. The no-ball siren goes off

drilled over Krishna's head. Gaikwad is showing everyone he has those higher gears. He ventures down the track, takes a length ball from the stumps and dumps it over the seamer's head. Impressive way to bring up a century opening stand
Gaikwad gets on top of a short ball outside off and glides it to backward point
pumped over mid-off. 115.6ks cutter just outside off, Nagarkoti lands it in Faf's slot. He stays leg-side of this slower variation and launches it down the ground
slower ball, short and wide of off, Gaikwad hauls a pull to the left of deep midwicket. He's trying to kick into a higher gear
dug in short and slanting into the body, 142.2ks, heaved to deep midwicket
seems like a slower offcutter, he delays his drive and pushes down to long-on. After three low scores, Gaikwad brings up a half-century - his fourth in IPL
down the track and belted over long-on for six. Gaikwad advances down the pitch, seam-up, shorter at the body, powered over the fence. Full marks to Gaikwad for intent and execution
back of a length on middle, angling in, Faf clears his front leg, widens his base, and hauls it away to deep midwicket
whipped from outside off to wide long-on off the back foot
shorter and spinning into middle, this offbreak is forced to deep midwicket off the back foot
floated up outside off, punched through the line to long-off
short and wide of off, chopped square through point
flatter, faster, spinning into middle, Gaikwad hangs back and blocks to cover
on a length and spins into middle, knocked into the leg side for one
short and fizzing into middle, forced off the back foot to deep midwicket
offbreak from Varun, whisked down to long-on with the spin
on a length, flat and spinning back in. Faf goes back and bunts it through square leg
short legcutter, Varun takes it away from the swinging arc, slashed to sweeper cover
much fuller and spins back into Gaikwad to strike the pad, Gaikwad falls over, but this seems to be shaping past leg stump
legcutter, back of a length and outside off, 95.4ks, punched past extra-cover to wide long-off

more short stuff from Russell, he gets it up higher, homing into Gaikwad's chest. The batter splices a pull in the air. Krishna runs in from long leg, attacks the ball and slides. But the ball lands in front of him and skips away to the boundary
dug in short and angling into middle, swivel-pulled to deep midwicket
back of a length and skidding into Faf, inside-edged onto the pad
on a length and outside off, Gaikwad opens the bat-face and glides it to deep third man
slower legcutter, Gaikwad delays his shot and blocks quietly to the leg side
swatted over midwicket. Short and angling into the body, Gaikwad reads the length early. He switches back and pulls this hip-high delivery over the leg side for six
short and outside off, punched solidly to sweeper cover off the back foot

edged but eludes a diving Russell at first slip. Pushed through flatter and quicker outside off, Gaikwad has a hard-handed slash and edges it thickly past the right of Russell who is standing fine at slip
on a length and veers away outside off, may have been another knuckle ball, steered off the face to point
on a length and wide of off, knuckle ball, which is cracked straight to extra-cover. Hit with so much force that the ball bursts out of the hands of the infielder
fuller and breaks back in to hit the thigh pad, but this is heading down leg with the sharp angle and spin to boot
Narine hides the ball behind his back and then spears it just a shade outside off, squeezed to cover

back of a length and skidding back in at 143.1ks, pings the glove, and the impact makes Faf drop his bat. He runs across to the other end for a single. The CSK physio Tommy Simsek is out to tend to Faf
good length and slanting into middle, clipped neatly past the right of midwicket
short and veering into the chest, fended off to the leg side off the back foot
banged in short and shoved down the leg side for wide
back of a length and angling into middle, Gaikwad camps back and works it past the right of midwicket
pitched up and wide of off, Gaikwad reaches out for the ball and latches onto the width. He opens the bat-face and drives it languidly between point and cover-point
on a length and Cummins brings this back into Faf, pushed to mid-on from a middle-stump line
Krishna drags his length back and targets the stumps, played back to him
pitched up and width, right in Gaikwad's slot. He springs forward and punchily drives it between extra-cover and mid-off. So easy on the eye...
moves away past the shoulder of the bat like a quick legcutter! Back of a length, angling in and then jags away past the bat
fullish and outside off, Gaikwad presses forward and bunts it defensively to extra-cover
Gaikwad gets behind this short ball angling in towards off and defends
back of a length and slanting into off, Faf opens the bat-face and slices a drive between cover-point and extra-cover. Tripathi chases hard and cuts it off to three
on a length and Varun brings this back into Faf, finishes on off stump, inside-edged onto the pad
....but this goes over wide long-off for six. Varun tosses it up outside off, Faf backs away outside leg, and laces it inside-out over the off side. Top shot from a top player
back of a length and darted into off, Faf goes back and forces it to mid-on
darted short and wide of off, Faf slashes a cut between backward point and short third man for four
Gaikwad backs away outside leg, manufactures swinging room, and lofts this slower ball over extra-cover. Wide long-off hunts it down
looped in the air, but to the right of Varun. Looks like a wrong'un, sticks in the pitch and bounces at Gaikwad. He nearly plops a return catch
top ball to close out the over. Narine lands the ball on the seam, the new ball pitches on off and swings away past the outside edge once again. It wasn't too far away from the off stump
Narine hides the ball behind his back and gets it to veer into the pads of Faf, nudged square of Varun at short fine leg
shorter and breaks away outside off, Narine zips another one past Faf's outside edge
faster and shorter, the line is wider, Faf uses the pace of Narine to his advantage, opens the face, and dinks it to the left of short third man for four
fuller again, draws Faf forward but it shapes away past the outside edge. Legbreak? DK flips the bails off, but du Plessis drags his back leg back in time
fullish and sliding in at off stump, du Plessis moves forward and tips it to cover
pumped over midwicket for six! Shortish and angling into the body, but this is only a hip-high delivery around off. Gaikwad swivels on the back foot and pulls it firmly over the leg side
Cummins immediately drags his length back and attacks the stumps, played to mid-on off the back foot
Sweet as.... 140ks, on a length and outside off. Not a half-volley, Gaikwad stretches out and crunnnnnnches it between extra-cover and point
on a length and slanting in at off stump, Gaikwad presses forward and blocks straight to short midwicket
back of a length and skidding into off stump, bunted away to the right of short midwicket
Cummins pounds it on a hard length and gets it to hold its line outside off. Faf still pierces the gap on the off side. He leans back and punches it strongly between extra-cover and point
punched down to long-on to close out a tight first over
back of a length and sliding into middle, punched to the right of mid-on
looped up and spins away outside off, Gaikwad reaches out for the ball and jabs to covers
jumps from a length and spins in at off, Varun draws an inside edge from Faf this time. Prodded to the leg side
legbreak from Varun, swerves away outside off, pushed away to the left of Varun
back of a length and fizzing into off,googly inside-edged back to the bowler

Krishna is caught short on the second. Another run-out from Chahar does it for CSK. The TV umpire confirms it. Heartbreak for Cummins and KKR. Joy for CSK. Thakur searches for the wide yorker, comes out as a low full-toss. It's still a hard-to-hit low full-toss. Plinked down to long-off. Chahar runs across, swoops down on the ball, throws it to Thakur. The seamer holds his nerve, gathers the ball cleanly, and flips the bails off to catch Krishna short. Krishna stumbled on the first and wasn't quick enough in the end. CSK jump to the top of the points table
middle-stump yorker, jammed out to point with an open face. Krishna keeps it out
another one on the pads, Curran gets away with it, diverted off the pads behind square. Cummins and Krishna cross over
pitched up on the stumps, Curran is missing his lengths, hauled to Faf at long-on. Cummins keeps strike

overpitched and outside off, belted straight of long-off. There's no second here, but Varun sacrifices his wicket to bring the big-hitting Cummins back on strike. Varun is caught short on the second. Nice, flat throw from Chahar
Cummins whips it over square leg for six. Fullish and on the pads, misses the yorker and it comes out as a slot ball, which is hoisted with the wrists over the leg side
middle-stump yorker, dug out. Good start to the over from Curran
slot ball outside off, belted through the line to the left of Gowtham at wide long-off. Cummins settles with the single. He has the strike now
wide yorker, inside the tramline, Cummins chucks his hands at the ball and slices it over short third man off the outer half
another legcutter, well wide of off. Thakur is under pressure
Thakur floats another cutter past the tramline. Another off-side wide
back of a length and wobbles away past the tramline, off-side wide
Thakur goes for the wide yorker, comes out as a wide full-toss, carved to Jadeja at sweeper. Another dot
full-toss, wide of off, drilled to Jadeja at sweeper. Cummins turns down the single on offer
sliced in the air over extra-cover, Gowtham has to run across to his right from sweeper. Cummins hares back for the second again
legcutter outside off, punched wide of sweeper. Cummins sprints back and brings up a 23-ball fifty
short and outside off, chopped away to the left of sweeper cover. KKR don't take the single. Good over from Ngidi
full-toss on off, lofted in the air, but lands in front of Faf at long-on
bursts through Dhoni's gloves for four. Wide yorker, pings the foot holes, bounces up and beats Dhoni

The South African pair combine to get rid of Nagarkoti. Du Plessis dives forward and takes it. Back of a length on middle, Ngidi hits the hard length once again. The line is on middle. The bat-face turns on impact as Nagarkoti holes out for a duck
Ngidi hits a hard length on middle, played back to the bowler

Mowed over wide long-on. Cummins has brought KKR back into the game with 6,6,6,4,6. Slower offcutter from around the wicket, he clears his front leg and dismisses it out of his sight with immense power
Cummins follows the hat-trick of sixes with a four. Is Curran struggling to grip the ball? He searches for the yorker, sends a wide full-toss, bludgeoned over extra-cover
sweet clunk as Cummins dispatches the ball over square leg. Very full and veering into the pads, poor ball from Curran and he cops punishment
shanked over Curran's head for six. On a length and outside off, Cummins holds his shape and clears the straight boundary
back of a length and angling across off, Cummins sizes it up and smears it over long-off for six
pumped away in the air to the left of wide long-off. Cummins comes back for the second

Ngidi is showcasing his variations. He traps DK lbw, the batter calls for a review. DK uses his feet, Ngidi slips in the big dipper. This is a low full-toss straight out of the Bravo playbook. Pings the back leg and this is crashing into leg stump. DK has to go
off-stump yorker, jammed down to long-on
follows the yorker with an in-to-the-pitch cutter. Cummins has a leg-side hack and misses
Ngidi nails the wide yorker, nips away and bounces after hitting the ground. Sneaks under Cummins' swing before bouncing up
clubbed over long-on. Slower ball offcutter, full and lands in Cummins' swinging arc. He lines it up and sends it over Faf
fullish and outside off, spanked through the line to long-off
carved to the left of extra-cover and right of sweeper. Gowtham, the sub, slides to his left and is in contact with the ad hoarding while swatting the ball back into play
hammered straight of long-on. Even Faf can't hunt that down. Thakur misses the wide yorker. Full-toss, which is carted down the ground
wide yorker, just inside the tramline, is it? Thakur gets away with that as Cummins lets it pass
full-toss outside off, sliced down to long-off
full-toss outside off, carved to Curran at mid-off
wide yorker, squirted away square through the off side
arm ball on middle, played back to Jadeja
Karthik feigns to step away, then shuffles back in line to drive a full ball outside off to wide long-off
darted outside off, lashed away to the left of sweeper cover. Karthik sprints back for the second
shorter and spins away outside off, chopped off the back foot. A fumble from Ngidi gives Cummins the strike and puts Karthik back on strike
on a length and angling into middle, played back to the bowler
sliced to point off the outside half
mowed between deep midwicket and wide long-on. Down the track and flat-batted fiercely in the gap
clears Ngidi at deep square leg. Short and slanting into the hips, Karthik sizes it up and pulls it off his hips for six
full and wide of off, looks like another cutter that beats Karthik outside off
slower offcutter on middle, defended to cover with an open bat-face

Sam Curran: Makes things happen! Russell leaves it and gives Curran free access to his leg stump. Russell was thinking Curran would go full and wide like Thakur did last over. However, he hits a back of a length, Russell swerves outside off, doesn't offer a shot, and is castled. Or maybe Russell was thinking it would slant down the leg side. Anyway, smart stuff from Curran
on a length and angling across off, punched handsomely to sweeper cover

launched over long-off. Russell slams a 21-ball half-century. Darted outside off, Russell backs away, manufactures swinging room and smites it down the ground once again. What a costly error from Jadeja
back of a length and spins away outside off, sliced off the outer half to short third man once again. The no-ball siren goes off belatedly. Jadeja comes back to re-bowl it
on a length and spins away slightly from Russell, defended to short third man with an open face
darted short and on leg stump, hauled away to deep square leg
speared into middle, flat and quick, dragged in the air but lands in front of Moeen at wide long-on
looped up on off, forward and eased down to long-off
DK joins the fun! Shortish and sliding into off, he jumps back and pulls strongly over midwicket
shanked over midwicket. On-pace back of a length ball outside off, Russell clears his front leg and launches it between deep midwicket and wide long-on. 24 off Thakur's first over
wide yorker, Thakur finally gets it right and beats Russell outside off
full and wide of off, inside the tramline. Russell slashes and does not make contact
flat-batted in the air to the left of deep cover. Moeen tears across to his left, gets into a side-on position, but the ball bursts through his hands for six. Moeen trips beyond the boundary
on a length and outside off, Russell swings for the hills and slices an outside edge between Dhoni and short third man
full and wide once again, too wide. Thakur has to re-bowl it
Russell puts Thakur under pressure immediately. Thakur veers away from the initial plan - full and wide - and digs a short ball down the leg side
full and wide of off, Russell reaches out for the ball and muscles it away in the air, to the left of deep point. Clears the bigger side of the ground with ease
whipped away wide of midwicket
back of a length, drifting in and spinning away. Russell checks his shot and pats it to point
tapped down to long-off
whacked to the midwicket boundary. Dragged down outside off, DK jumps back so very quickly and pulls over midwicket
tossed up around off, spins away just enough, Karthik plays with soft hands, ensuring it doesn't carry to Raina at slip
sliding in at off, full in length. Russell dinks to cover with an open face
slower ball outside off, defends towards backward point. That's the time out
heaves it over square leg. Poor over from Chahar. A length ball disappeared earlier. Now a short ball gets the same treatment. Strong pull shot from DK
defends a fuller delivery that gets a hint of away movement.
pulls a back of a length ball to midwicket
low full toss outside off, he drives to long-off
launches it over long-on. It's a length ball. The kind he usually wallops in his sleep. All it takes is a clearing of the front leg and a full swing of the arms
pushes a quicker, flatter delivery outside off to long-off
flicks a full ball on leg stump through midwicket
he's slowing it down today and it's working. Tosses it up on middle and leg and gets enough turn to force Karthik into a block

outside edge wanders between keeper and slip and away to the boundary. Lovely bowling from Jadeja. Angling a good length ball in to cramp Karthik, and getting sufficient turn to keep the batsman honest facing such a line of attack
defends a good length ball towards cover point
pulls the short ball - even though it sticks in the pitch a bit - to long-on. Holds his shape well, Karthik
slower-ball offcuter from Ngidi, floats it too full and outside off. Russell gets under it and smites a six over mid-off
short and Russell latches onto width outside off. Cracked off the back foot, but can't beat the packed off-side infield
just short of a good length and outside off, Russell clears his front leg and slogs it powerfully in the air to the right of midwicket
overpitched and outside off, Russell camps back, his feet don't move, but the hands do all the work. Driven between cover-point and extra-cover

KKR are five down and sinking. Banged in short and keeps coming back into Tripathi with the sharp angle from over the wicket. Too close to the body for the late cut/attempted ramp. Tripathi leans back and simply guides it into the gloves of Dhoni
on a length and outside off, driven to extra-cover

Jadeja springs into the action. He throws himself to his right from short cover and makes this catch look ridiculously easy. This why Chahar wants 11 Jadejas in the field. Chahar immediately drags his length back and adjusts his line. He targets the stumps, Narine makes some swinging room and slaps it to Jadeja
No, Deepak. Wrong line and length. Overpitched and outside off, Narine camps back, frees his arms and crunnnnnches through the covers
bouncer, angling across off, Narine sways his upper body out of the way
Chahar comes back and has Morgan nicking off. He celebrates it with a big roar. Nicely pitched up, angling away and swinging away outside off. Morgan flashes a drive and edges behind to Dhoni
back of a length and angling across off, down the track and heaved away between midwicket and mid-on off the inside half
Tripathi dinks another single to deep third man
fullish and outside off, offcutter, 117ks, guided to deep third man
another slower ball on the hips, clipped down to long leg. Thakur runs across, fumbles, then recovers to slide and haul the ball in
slower ball, shortish and on the hips. Morgan waits on it before knocking it defensively to short midwicket
Ngidi slams it on a hard length. Morgan hops and fends it off to the off side
back of a length and Ngidi gets it to seam back in against the angle to beat the inner edge
short and on the hips, flapped to short midwicket
short, yes, but angled down the leg side. Wide
good-length inswinger, blocked with the movement to the leg side

Ngidi runs in from long leg. Dhoni runs across to his left and settles under this skier near the square-leg region. He takes it after a brief stumble. This was on a length and swinging into the pads. Instead of putting it away to the fence, Rana skews it in the air off a leading edge and gives his wicket away
on a length, pitches on middle, swerves away outside off. The outswing squares up Rana and beats his outside edge
back of a length and outside off, Tripathi now taps to deep third man
shorter at the hips, tucked down to long leg
shortish and outside off, angled down to Ngidi at deep third man
Curran rolls out another cutter, 112ks, sliced in the air, but lands in front of short third man. These slower ones are sticking in the Wankhede pitch
good length and Curran brings this back in, looks like an offcutter from Curran, inside-edged past off stump
bouncer from Curran, Rana ducks under it, wide called for height
swing for Curran, but the length is too short and the line is wide. Swished to extra-cover
Rana shuffles outside leg, thrashes outside off and misses this length ball that holds its line outside off
good length and homing into the pads, picked away fine for four. The man in the deep is too square to cut it off
sliced past short third man for four. Full and hung up outside off, a crease-bound Rana drives away from the body and away from that infielder
down the track and clobbered past extra-cover. Tripathi charges down the track, takes it from just outside off, and smites it past Santner, the sub fielder
very full and Chahar bends this back in at off, this inswinger is stabbed back off the inside half
slashed straight to deep third man. Short and wide of off, Gill chucks his hands at the ball and holes out to Ngidi who takes a couple of steps forward and snaffles it. Gill goes for a golden duck
shorter and swinging away outside off, the length allows Rana to sit back and punch it to deep third man
